newsitem.title: USA: CytRx adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: CytRx adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: CytRx Corp said Thursday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect shareholders in the event of a takeover bid.

The rights plan provides that one preferred stock purchase right will be distributed as a dividend on each outstanding share of common stock of the company held of record as of the close of business on May 15.

President and Chief Executive Jack Luchese said in a statement that the plan would not prevent a takeover but was designed to encourage any individual or group seeking control of CytRx to negotiate with its board of directors.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information on the plan.
CytRx is a biopharmaceutical company that is developing treatments for vascular, infectious diseases, burns and cancer.
A company spokeswoman said later Thursday that the shareholder rights plan would be triggered if an individual or group acquired 15 percent or more of CytRx's stock.
